description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
vibe: Deterministic task runners, disciplined formatting, and modular consistency.
highlights: AnyPS5 relinks PS5 executables into native Linux or Windows programs that run against reimplemented system libraries; it is not an emulator. The rules are [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [CONVENTIONS](docs/dev/CONVENTIONS.md); these are the ones agents break.
No comments in code, except `#endif` and namespace ends.
An export you cannot implement calls `NotImplemented_nid_no_patch(__func__)`; never return a made-up success.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
